title: Resend centred quote
description: A glow-framed band: a round dark mark holding a company glyph, a large centred quote in near-white, and an avatar with name and role. A small pill link sits under it on phones; on desktop it stays hidden until the band is hovered, then fades in.
notes: the avatar is a media slot (a placeholder circle until filled)
name: resend-quote

props.name: mark
props.description: the company's glyph in the round mark (an svg or lucide icon)

props.name: author
props.type: { name: string; role: string; avatar?: ReactNode; }

props.name: link
props.description: the small pill link (hidden until hover on desktop)
